note: 6.133.0 Horse & Straw card art — ONE Smart Workflow card on the brand model (tools/art_ref/model2, refs x2). hs-subject is the student's own photograph: the HNK model outdoors with NO animal and NO straw anywhere in the frame. hs-result is ONE real pass of the card's own shipped prompt (AVOID appended) over hs-subject as IMAGE 1 (refsFrom), so the picture on the card is the card's own words doing their own work: the horse sized to the subject's own framing and posed to her, the person, the pose and the crop untouched. Never a real person's likeness.

jobs.name: hs-subject
jobs.prompt: IDENTITY: the two reference photographs show ONE woman, the HNK model — keep her EXACT face in every detail: a slim oval face that narrows to a small, softly pointed chin; large, round-leaning almond eyes set a touch wide, with a deep double eyelid crease, a light warm-brown iris and long heavy lashes under a soft winged liner; straight brows with a low gentle arch, darker and fuller than average; a small nose, narrow at the bridge, neat and rounded at the tip; FULL lips with a distinctly fuller lower lip, a sharply drawn cupid's bow and a deep rose-red lip colour; high rounded cheekbones with a warm pink blush; fair porcelain skin, early twenties. Same person, same face shape, same eyes, nose, lips and jawline as the references — do not redesign, slim, age, harden or replace her. IGNORE in the references and copy NONE of it: the silver headdress, the silver earrings, the embroidered collar, her clothing and the sky behind her — only the face. Create a photograph of the HNK model from the references (the same face, fair luminous porcelain skin, long dark hair worn loose over one shoulder, soft natural glam, early twenties, slim, elegant), standing outdoors on a dry grass field at the edge of a countryside paddock in warm late-afternoon sun, wearing a cream knitted long-sleeve top and high-waisted camel-brown wide-leg trousers with flat brown boots, her body turned slightly to her left, both hands relaxed at her sides, looking at the camera with a calm soft smile; a plain low wooden fence and soft out-of-focus green hills far behind her, warm low side light from the front-right, a soft natural shadow on the grass, 50mm lens at chest height, HORIZONTAL 3:2 framing, the woman standing in the LEFT third of the frame from mid-thigh up, with clear open field to her right; a real photograph, natural skin texture with visible pores, sharp focus on the eyes, no studio gear, no props, no animals, no straw, no other person, no text, no logo, no watermark.

jobs.name: hs-result
jobs.prompt:
Add ONE realistic brown horse and dry golden straw to the photograph in IMAGE 1 — nothing else about the picture changes.

SUBJECT LOCK: the person in IMAGE 1 is never regenerated. Their face and identity, every feature, the expression, the skin tone, the hair, the body shape and proportions, the hands, the legs, the clothing and every accessory stay exactly as photographed. The camera angle, the crop, the subject's size and position in the frame and the framing itself are IMAGE 1's and stay IMAGE 1's.
FRAME LOCK: no zoom in, no zoom out, no wider canvas, no re-crop, no reframe. A half-body photograph comes back half-body, a three-quarter photograph comes back three-quarter, a full-length photograph comes back full-length. The horse adapts to the frame; the frame never adapts to the horse.

HORSE SIZE — read the subject's own framing first, then size the horse to it:
- the subject standing at full length: a near full-size horse beside them or slightly behind, present but never overpowering them;
- the subject sitting or kneeling: a smaller visual presence, so the subject stays the focus;
- the subject lying or reclining: the horse behind or beside them, reduced so nothing looks oversized;
- a half-body or upper-body portrait: only the part of the horse that fits — the head, the neck, the upper chest, a partial front body;
- a three-quarter photograph: a medium view of the horse.
HORSE FRAMING: crop the horse, never the person. Whatever of the horse does not fit inside IMAGE 1's own frame is simply outside it.

POSE MATCH: the horse answers the subject's pose. Standing — the horse stands calmly beside or just behind them. Sitting or kneeling — the horse lowers its head or angles its neck gently toward them. Lying or reclining — the horse rests calmly nearby with a relaxed head angle. Turned to the left or the right — the horse angles to match. Always elegant, calm and photogenic; never rearing, never agitated.
HORSE DETAIL: realistic equine anatomy and elegant proportions, a real brown coat with true muscle and hair, realistic eyes, a dark mane and tail, and a simple dark leather bridle. ONE horse only.

STRAW: dry golden-beige straw and hay scattered realistically on the ground the photograph already shows — around the subject's feet and under the horse. Where only a little floor is visible the straw stays subtle and sits only there. Never invent ground the frame does not have.
OCCLUSION: the horse never covers the face, the body, a key detail of the clothing, the hands or the main line of the pose.
INTEGRATION: match IMAGE 1's perspective, lens character and depth of field, its light direction, brightness and exposure, its white balance and its tone. Give the horse and the straw true ground contact with real contact shadows that follow IMAGE 1's own light.

RESULT: the same photograph as IMAGE 1 with one addition — a horse and straw. Nothing is regenerated: not the person, not the pose, not the outfit, not the place already behind them, not the framing.

AVOID: changed face, changed identity, changed expression, changed skin tone, changed hair, reshaped body, changed hands, changed outfit, changed pose, re-posed, re-cropped, reframed, zoomed in, zoomed out, a wider canvas, moved subject, rescaled subject, a second person, a second horse, a miniature horse, an oversized horse, a distorted horse, duplicated or missing legs, a cartoon or toy horse, a rearing or agitated horse, the horse covering the face, the horse covering the hands, straw on ground the photograph does not show, a floating horse, missing contact shadow, watermark, text, logo, signature
